summary: Recent updates to the WebRender bindings in Firefox focused primarily on improving stability and memory management. Notably, the changes ensure that the webrender worker threads properly shut down during leak-checking builds, which helps in identifying memory leaks more effectively. Additionally, fixes were applied to address memory leaks associated with the SavedD3D11State helper class, enhancing overall performance. Importantly, these updates also introduce support for binding MacIOSurfaceTextureHosts to textures when using EGL/ANGLE, which improves compatibility and rendering capabilities on Mac devices. **These enhancements not only help developers maintain a more efficient and stable graphics rendering pipeline but also contribute to a smoother browsing experience for users.**
